title: Arcturus
description: A simple and easy to use server plugin which adds many useful features.
body:
## ⭐ Arcturus

**Arcturus** is a modern all-in-one **Paper utility & management plugin** for Minecraft **1.21+**, focused on moderation, quality-of-life features, and server systems — all built using Paper’s modern APIs.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🏷️ Rank System
A built-in rank system with commands and configuration support.

- **`/rank add <rank> <player>`** – Assign a rank to a player  
- Default ranks:
  - `vip`
  - `mod`
  - `admin`
  - `manager` *(operator-level, not customizable)*

- **Customizable ranks**
  - `vip`, `mod`, and `admin` can be fully customized
  - View and edit options with:
    - **`/rank config <rank>`**

---

### 🏠 Homes System
- Set and teleport to homes
- Custom **GUI menu** for managing homes
- Clean and intuitive design

---

### 🛒 Shop & Economy
- Integrated **economy system**
- Custom shop interface
- **`/sell`** command to sell items instantly
- Every sellable item shows its **price directly on the item**

---

### 📊 Scoreboard
A persistent sidebar scoreboard showing:
- Server name
- Ping
- Kills
- Deaths
- Money balance

---

### 🧰 Utility Commands
- **`/echest [player]`**  
  Open your own or another player’s Ender Chest  
  Aliases: `/ec`, `/enderchest`

- **`/invsee <player>`**  
  View another player’s inventory in real time

---

### 🛠 World Management
- **`/deletechunk`**  
  Clears the chunk you are standing in  
  ✔ Fully undoable

- **`/undo`**  
  Undo the last destructive action

---

### 🌊 Environment Tools
- **`/drain`**  
  Fully implemented area-drain command

---

### 🕵️ Moderation
- **`/vanish`**  
  Toggle invisibility for staff members

---

## ⚙️ Technical Details
- Built **specifically for Paper**
- Uses **Paper’s modern command lifecycle system**
- No legacy Bukkit command registration
- Modular and extensible codebase
- Designed for performance and stability

---

## 📦 Requirements
- **Paper** `1.21+`
- Java **21**
- Might work on other verisions than 1.21.11 but you could try it because I have not yet tested it for other verisions than 1.21.11 

> ❌ Not compatible with Spigot or Bukkit

---

## 🚀 Status
Actively developed and expanding.  
Designed to serve as a **core plugin** for small and medium servers.
